marketed_identity: Maxon; OEM for Ibanez and other labels
model_or_product: Maxon OD-801 D&S; Ibanez OD-850; Ibanez Standard Fuzz / No. 59; related early OEM fuzz/fuzz-wah families
evidence_summary: Nisshin Onpa is documented by company-history interviews and multiple historical sources as the physical manufacturer behind Maxon effects and numerous OEM products. Independent historical research identifies Nisshin Onpa manufacture of the Maxon OD-801 and Ibanez OD-850, and ToneHome documents pre-Maxon unbranded OEM fuzz/fuzz-wah production for brands including Aria and Greco. Preserve Nisshin Onpa as manufacturer, Maxon as its marketed brand, and Ibanez/Aria/Greco/etc. as separate marketed identities or OEM relationships.
